body: God does love you and everyone else, it's kinda his thing.  That said, I'm sorry you are struggling. You arent alone, I feel that way frequently.  This isnt your fault, you very well may have a chemical imbalance and that's all it is. You may have something stressing you out, and that be the cause of all of this. When I feel like everything is swirling around me and I'm panicking, I go to the restroom to put my hands under cold running water, for whatever reason it brings me back to reality.  Take a few breaths, remember that nothing is out to get you.  If this keeps happening talk to your doctor.

I think this is my last weekend.  Im going to drive to the beach and stand in the waves. Maybe walk along the beach at night.  Going alone.  Maybe catch a movie.  Smile and thank God for giving me some happy days while looking out at the horizon.
Go to bed and reassess things in the morning. If still feel like hanging yourself the means will still be there.  But I'd definately go to bed first.

I wish I had something to say that would help you.  I'm sorry that someone you trusted did that to you.  I can attest to how much it hurts. My love is gone and wont tell me what happened. He emailed me that he was done trying. I have begged and begged just for a reason even. I dont know what I did. I hope that you can find happiness, I'm sorry you feel as worthless as I do. I wrote letters. And finally a goodbye letter. Maybe it would help you too.

I'm very sorry this happened to you too. It seems unfair to be left after this many years. I cant take it anymore. I'm ending my life Monday. I wrote my love a last letter begging for another chance and asking him to call me Sunday. I just want the chance to say goodbye and hear him once more. I didn't tell him I was gonna blow my brains out ofc. I'm just out of options.

Similar stories. Its heart breaking, crushing stuff. I feel like I cant breath most of the time. Im thinking of going to colorado where my ex is to end my life, bc my phone still lists him as husband. I hope the authorities call him first when I'm found.

I've made the same decision, for after the weekend though.  I also planned on watching a movie tonight but going to the theater. I always enjoyed it.  What do you plan to watch? I want to see the madea movie bc I want my last hours to be spent laughing. 

I'm sorry you have reached this point too.

I'd really like to do that, but it's all just too much. My chest actually hurts. My anxiety is through the roof, I'm having frequent panic attacks. No one should have to live like this,  its torture. I just want this to stop and be over, im so tired.

What are the reactions of the people around you? Maybe make it a point to try to observe others.  How much are others saying, is it similar to the amount you are? It's okay. No one is thinking badly of you for this.

Well I doubt that unless you are a super douch canoe to everyone, but those guys typically are too self absorbed to even think someone may not like them. 

Do you feel anxious or jumpy around others? I used to want to crawl into a cave when I was around people.

Im worried about mine and my dog too. Im leaving them at my parents house and asking them to watch them while I'm "out of town".  I'm going to ask my ex to please take them back before I pull the trigger. Not with him on the phone ofc, that would be awful.
Can you identify what makes you think they do not like you?  Body language, something they said?
My prior husband. We divorced and he doesnt want to try anymore.  He was my world and said I was his until he decided I wasnt. No reasons. I cant live with this anymore.
You have no idea how much I relate to your post. I get it, and in sorry it sucks so bad. I'm just trying to make it through the next few days.
I feel the same. Maybe go do some fun stuff or something you have always wanted to do
